title: Signal: Kubernetes kubeconfig served
scope: One response whose body is a kubeconfig document with a clusters list and certificate-authority-data.
limitations: One response body. The rule reports the kubeconfig shape; it does not use the credential and cannot determine the role bound to it.

observation.body:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Config
clusters:
- cluster:
    certificate-authority-data: LS0tLS1CRUdJTiBDRVJUSUZJQ0FURS0tLS0t
    server: https://k8s.internal:6443
  name: prod
users:
- name: deployer
  user:
    token: eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImFiYw

apiVersion: v1
kind: Config

- cluster:
    : LS0tLS1CRUdJTiBDRVJUSUZJQ0FURS0tLS0t
    server: https://k8s.internal:6443
  name: prod
users:
- name: deployer
  user:
    token: eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImFiYw

fpNotes: A kubeconfig with no user credential is still reported, because the API server address and CA are disclosed as well.
